entries: The {rival} had been {first}'s handler all along, out of {MOTIVE}.
{the_message:physical} was sent by {CLOSE:human}, to make {first} run {MANNER}.
The safe house at {landmark:built} was the trap, and {the_someone:human} had built it.
{the_disaster:manmade} was a diversion {MANNER}, built to bury {TOPIC}.
{the_someone:human} had been answering to {SOMEONE:authority,!plural} all along, out of {MOTIVE}.
The witness was never gone: {the_someone:human,!plural} had staged the hiding {MANNER}.
{the_thing:!living} was a decoy to keep {first} running while {SOMEONE:human,!plural} moved {THING:portable}.
{first} had held {the_thing:!living} {HIDING} the whole time, and the {rival} knew.
{CLOSE:human} had sold {first}'s route to the {rival} {MANNER}, out of {MOTIVE}.
Every exit was watched by {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, because {first} was never meant to escape.
The countdown was a lie: {the_disaster:manmade} had already begun {MANNER}.
Everyone wanted {the_thing:portable}, but only {the_someone:human} knew what it unlocked.
